# Zyllo Tech

> Zyllo Tech is a software engineering company based in Hyderabad, India, delivering web and mobile applications, AI/ML solutions, cloud DevOps, cybersecurity, and quality engineering for businesses in India, the US, and globally.

- [LangChain vs LlamaIndex for RAG](https://zyllotech.com/blog/langchain-vs-llamaindex-rag): the same task in both frameworks, and where retrieval quality is won
- [API Design Principles](https://zyllotech.com/blog/api-design-principles): resource naming, error envelopes, cursor pagination, versioning and deprecation
- [Design Systems That Scale](https://zyllotech.com/blog/design-systems-that-scale): three-tier token architecture, component governance, Figma-to-code sync
- [AI in Enterprise Software](https://zyllotech.com/blog/ai-reshaping-enterprise-software-2025): the five AI patterns in enterprise builds, and the agentic shift through 2026
- [Micro-Interactions in UX](https://zyllotech.com/blog/micro-interactions-ux): feedback, state transitions, and motion that aids rather than decorates
- [Writing a Software RFP](https://zyllotech.com/blog/software-rfp-guide): what to include so vendors can quote accurately, and what to leave out
